rules.text: A change to headings 1801 through 1805 from any other chapter.
A change to tariff items 1806.10.43, 1806.10.45, 1806.10.55, 1806.10.65 or 1806.10.75 from any other heading.

A change to subheading 1806.10 from any other heading, provided that the nonoriginating sugar of chapter 17 constitutes no more than 35 percent by weight of the sugar and the nonoriginating cocoa powder of heading 1805 constitutes no more than 35 percent by weight of the cocoa powder.
A change to subheading 1806.20 from any other heading.
A change to subheadings 1806.31 through 1806.90 from any other subheading, including another subheading within that group.
